cohort: 59 primigravida, healthy women; 28 who had requested and delivered by CS without an obstetrical indication and 31 who opted for a spontaneous vaginal delivery
finding: Maternal-request CS was strongly associated with age and fear of childbirth, but not significantly associated with intrapsychic variables except for the use of the defense mechanism projection.
mod_finding: The study focuses on maternal request for cesarean section and does not investigate other modes of delivery.
